=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:740-804 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE` (`(?:--repo|-R)(?:\s+|=)([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)`) needs a name character straight after the whitespace or `=`, so a quoted name such as `--repo "acme/consumer-app"` or `-R 'acme/other'` gets past the guard against another repository's credential step; `_clean` (lines 311-317) keeps the quotes.
  WHY: The step is classified as `credentials`, so `_check_credentials` returns `met` from this repository's own recent `review_autofix.yml`/`internal-review.yml`/`security-audit.yml` run, `tick` posts the done marker, and `_close_tracker_when_done` can close the tracker even though the other repository's secret was never set. The new tests cover only unquoted names. All reviewers rated this MAJOR. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite describes a different runtime effect: it says the regex captures the closing quote, the step stays open, and a legitimate tracker closure is blocked.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:743-804 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The organisation form `gh secret set GH_PAT --org acme --repos app1` never matches `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE`, because the alternation is only `(?:--repo|-R)` and `--repos` fails the `(?:\s+|=)` join; the classifier does not reject `org` or `repos` anywhere else.
  WHY: The step is classified as `credentials` and can be auto-ticked from this repository's own recent successful run (lines 841-865), which may close the tracker (lines 690-707) even though the credential setup targets another repository or organisation. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:735-800 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The preposition alternation in `CREDENTIAL_HANDOFF_RE`, `(?:to|for|with|from|in|into|at|via|by)`, leaves out `on`/`onto`. As a result, "Set GH_PAT" with the instruction "Paste it on the consumer portal." matches no handoff branch: "paste" is not in the send/share list, "consumer portal" is not "consumer repo", and "portal" is not a word in `HUMAN_OBJECT_TITLE_RE`.
  WHY: The step is classified as `credentials`, and the daily 06:00 `collect-logs` `tick --observable` auto-ticks it from this repository's own workflow-run proof and may close the tracker, although the human handoff never happened. Severity was MAJOR from gemini, minimax, luna and glm. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised it only as a hardening suggestion with no severity. Stated confidence ranged from 3 to 5.

- Hardening: scripts/operator_step_issue.py `CREDENTIAL_REPO_SLUG_RE`: insert `["']?` before the capture group and add a test row for `--repo "acme/consumer-app"` that expects `unrecognised` (about 2 lines).

Add `on|onto` and a test row (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
